_note: v0.38.0 (plan v0.38.0-scan-input QĐ 19, M3) SSR contract scan-input@1 (ADR 0012): td_scan_input() prints by default a NATIVE single field (`div.td-scan` > label + box > `input.td-scan__input` with name / value / required — works without JS, Enter submits); element mode (`element => true`) wraps the same field in `<td-scan-input data-td-ssr="scan-input@1">`, adopted IN PLACE through the shared form gate. `multiple => true` is always the element: input (no name) + `textarea.td-scan__fallback[name]` + `ul.td-scan__list` (li per value) + one hidden input per value, adopted through the component's own gate. Shared by test/php/td-ssr-scan-input.test.js (PHP output) and src/form/td-scan-input.ssr.engines.browser-test.js (Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, via test/ssr/fixtures/scan-input.html — GENERATED by `node test/ssr/build-scan-input-fixture.mjs`; the PHP test fails when it is stale). `expect`: the state the hydrated element must hold. `dropped`: `attrs` entries that must reach neither the host nor the input.
